title: Borrowed Name
text: Every offered hand carries a name that briefly replaces your own.
origin: A chorus fragment survived by hiding inside the operative's identity.
burdenText: The first assistance contribution each round is reduced by 1, minimum zero.
adaptationText: After that assisted test succeeds, gain +1 on your next unassisted skill test that round.
trigger: The first assistance contribution each round.
penalty: Reduce that contribution by 1, minimum zero.

effect.text: Borrowed Name retained an echo of the assisted test.

relief: Purge this Scar at the Sable Machine Choir.
upside: A successful assisted test primes the next unassisted test for +1.
